name: Qwen3-Coder-Next-REAM
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from Qwen/Qwen3-Coder-Next (config.json max_position_embeddings 262144). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
attention_variant: Inherited unchanged from Qwen/Qwen3-Coder-Next: 12 full GQA layers (kv heads 2, head_dim 256) and 36 other layers, per the base config.json.
notes: ADDED 2026-10-30. A merge-then-prune compression of Qwen/Qwen3-Coder-Next: REAM groups experts and merges before pruning, reducing 512 -> 384 experts per MoE layer, 79.7B -> 60.3B total (3.0B active, 10 routed). Config otherwise the base's. Recorded because the card prints both models in one results table; AVG is exactly level (72.9 both), so this is a 25%%-smaller model at parity, not a capability gain. Licence apache-2.0, repo created 2026-02-11.

benchmarks.name: HumanEval
benchmarks.config: Card 'Results' table, row Qwen3-Coder-Next 92.7 vs Qwen3-Coder-Next-REAM 94.5. 512->384 experts per MoE layer (80B->60B), REAM merge-then-prune, code-weighted calibration (c4/math/code 0.0/0.3/0.7).

benchmarks.name: LiveCodeBench
benchmarks.config: Same table, base 47.5. AVG is exactly level at 72.9 for both, and IFeval 89.3/89.6, AIME25 80.0/80.0, GSM8K 85.3/85.4, GPQA-D 40.4/42.4 go the other way - recorded as compression at parity, not a capability gain.
